<thought>Using the high‑intensity peak at m/z 100.0524 Da, the monoisotopic mass matches the exact mass of C₅H₈O₂ (C = 5 × 12.0000 = 60.0000, H = 8 × 1.007825 = 8.0626, O = 2 × 15.994915 = 31.9898; total = 100.0524 Da). No additional heteroatom is required, so the molecular formula is C5H8O2.</thought>
<final_answer>C5H8O2</final_answer>
